description: Portable manifest for scripts/claude-workflow-init.sh. Declares the three-layer .claude/ workflow architecture (core / roster / project-local) that the installer transfers into any target repo. The installer is data-driven: it reads THIS file, it does not hardcode the paths.

core.policy: Vendored infrastructure. On EVERY run: a missing core file is (re)installed; an identical file is a no-op; a target file that DIFFERS is preserved and reported as a collision (never clobbered).
core.note_optional: The .claude/rules dir walk also carries tokyo-night.css, and picks up .claude/rules/spec-rubrics.md only when the source repo actually has it (a missing source file is silently skipped). Memory DIR content is treated as project-local and never wiped: core only ever writes the .gitkeep placeholders here.

roster.policy: The battle-tier agent roster. Installed on FIRST install (target has no WORKFLOW_VERSION). On a normal run it is audited but not grown: identical -> no-op, different -> collision (preserved + warned), missing -> left absent. With --update-roster, source agents missing from the target are added. Never overwrites a modified agent.
roster.deletion_tracking: A target-side .claude/agents/.removed file (one agent basename per line, e.g. 'php-pro.md' or 'php-pro', '#' comments allowed) lists agents the target intentionally dropped. Their names are skipped on first install and on --update-roster, so a deleted agent is never silently re-added.

project_local.policy: Scaffolded ONCE if absent, NEVER overwritten. These belong to the target project and the installer must not manage their content after creation.

entries.stub:
# CLAUDE.md

Project conventions and routing for agents working in this repository.
This file was scaffolded by `scripts/claude-workflow-init.sh` and is never
overwritten by re-running the installer. Replace this stub with the routing,
conventions and hard invariants for THIS project.

## Workflow

The development process (Scenario A/B, model routing, report template) is documented inline in the source repo's root `CLAUDE.md`; copy the sections you need into this file.
Durable rules and hard invariants live under [.claude/rules/](.claude/rules/).

## Conventions

- Conventional Commits in English; subject imperative, scope = module/concern.
- Branch + PR for new work; never commit directly to the trunk branch.
- Doc-parity: a code/contract change updates its doc in the same commit.
- Single source of truth: every fact lives in one file; others link, never copy.

## Routing

| Topic | Doc |
|---|---|
| Development process | this `CLAUDE.md` (inline) |
| Durable rules and invariants | [.claude/rules/](.claude/rules/) |

settings_merge.policy: Deep merge, never overwrite. permissions.{allow,deny,ask} are unioned (target entries kept, source entries appended, de-duplicated). hooks are unioned per event and de-duplicated by (matcher, command). All other target keys (enabledPlugins, extraKnownMarketplaces, env, ...) are preserved untouched; the fragment intentionally does not carry them.
